verdict.rationale: Composio is an agent integration platform, so scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for it, but the evidence pack never documents time-based or recurring scheduling. Its triggers are event-driven: they forward app events such as new Slack messages or GitHub commits to a webhook. Reacting to app events is an adjacent capability, not a recurring schedule, and the remote workbench and CLI only cover one-off execution.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
